description: Publishes governed state and directly matched county GDP aggregates from the BEA CAGDP1 archive.
retry: Exponential backoff for the single official archive request; fail after four total attempts.
checkpoint: The archive and derived records are run-scoped; the manifest and current pointer publish only after schema, geography, and coverage gates pass.
idempotency: Each successful build creates one immutable release and atomically updates current.json after publication.
cancellation: Abort the active request and leave no shared lock; unpublished staging remains isolated by run ID.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public aggregate releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
